original: مَٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translit: Maaliki Yawmid-Deen
translation: Master of the Day of Judgment,
translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

original: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُصْلِحُونَ
translit: Wa izaa qeela lahum laa tufsidoo fil ardi qaalo innamaa nahnu muslihoon
translation: And when it is said unto them: Make not mischief in the earth, they say: We are peacemakers only.
translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

original: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فِرَٰشًۭا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءًۭ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًۭا لَّكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًۭا وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
translit: Allazee ja'ala lakumul arda firaashanw wassamaaa'a binaaa 'anw wa anzala minassamaaa'i maaa'an fa akhraja bihee minas samaraati rizqal lakum falaa taj'aloo lillaahi andaadanw wa antum ta'lamoon
translation: Who hath appointed the earth a resting-place for you, and the sky a canopy; and causeth water to pour down from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you. And do not set up rivals to Allah when ye know (better).
translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

original: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
translit: Qaaloo subhaanaka laa 'ilma lanaaa illaa maa 'allamtanaaa innaka antal'aleemul hakeem
translation: They said: Be glorified! We have no knowledge saving that which Thou hast taught us. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Knower, the Wise.
translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ أُمَّ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، لَوْلاَ أَنَّهَا عَجِلَتْ لَكَانَ زَمْزَمُ عَيْنًا مَعِينًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَمَّا كَثِيرُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ فَحَدَّثَنِي قَالَ إِنِّي وَعُثْمَانَ بْنَ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ جُلُوسٌ مَعَ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، فَقَالَ مَا هَكَذَا حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أَقْبَلَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بِإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَأُمِّهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ وَهْىَ تُرْضِعُهُ، مَعَهَا شَنَّةٌ ـ لَمْ يَرْفَعْهُ ـ ثُمَّ جَاءَ بِهَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ وَبِابْنِهَا إِسْمَاعِيلَ‏.‏
translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu sa'iydin aabuw 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyrin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aayyuwba, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yarhamu alllahu aumma iismaa'iyla, lawlaa aannahaa 'ajilat lakaana zamzamu 'aynana ma'iynana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala alaansaariyyu haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aammaa kathiyru bnu kathiyrin fahaddathaniy qaala iinniy wa'uthmaana bna aabiy sulaymaana juluwsun ma'a sa'iydi bni jubayrin, faqaala maa hakadhaa haddathaniy abnu 'abbaasin, qaala aaqbala iibraahiymu biiismaa'iyla waaummihi 'alayhimu alssalaamu wahaa turdi'uhu, ma'ahaa shannaaun lam yarfa'hu thumma jaa'a bihaa iibraahiymu wabiabnihaa iismaa'iyla‏.‏
translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on the mother of Ishmael! Had she not hastened (to fill her water-skin with water from the Zamzam well). Zamzam would have been a stream flowing on the surface of the earth." Ibn `Abbas further added, "(The Prophet) Abraham brought Ishmael and his mother (to Mecca) and she was suckling Ishmael and she had a water-skin with her
translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَسْرُوقًا، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَكُنْ فَاحِشًا وَلاَ مُتَفَحِّشًا وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ مِنْ أَحَبِّكُمْ إِلَىَّ أَحْسَنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اسْتَقْرِئُوا الْقُرْآنَ مِنْ أَرْبَعَةٍ مِنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، وَسَالِمٍ مَوْلَى أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ، وَأُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، وَمُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sulaymaana, qaala sami'tu aabaa waaiilin, qaala sami'tu masruwqana, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'amrinw iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lam yakun faahishana walaa mutafahhishana waqaala ‏"‏ iinna min aahabbikum iilaaaa aahsanakum aakhlaaqana ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ astaqriiuwa alqurana min aarba'aain min 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin, wasaalimin mawlaa aabiy hudhayfaaa, waaubaaai bni ka'bin, wamu'aadhi bni jabalin ‏"‏‏.‏
translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) neither talked in an insulting manner nor did he ever speak evil intentionally. He used to say, "The most beloved to me amongst you is the one who has the best character and manners." He added, " Learn the Qur'an from (any of these) four persons. `Abdullah bin Mas`ud, Salim the freed slave of Abu Hudhaifa, Ubai bin Ka`b, and Mu`adh bin Jabal
translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ الْجُعْفِيُّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلاَ يُؤْذِي جَارَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَاسْتَوْصُوا بِالنِّسَاءِ خَيْرًا فَإِنَّهُنَّ خُلِقْنَ مِنْ ضِلَعٍ وَإِنَّ أَعْوَجَ شَيْءٍ فِي الضِّلَعِ أَعْلَاهُ فَإِنْ ذَهَبْتَ تُقِيمُهُ كَسَرْتَهُ وَإِنْ تَرَكْتَهُ لَمْ يَزَلْ أَعْوَجَ فَاسْتَوْصُوا بِالنِّسَاءِ خَيْرًا
translit: hadaathanaa iishaaqu bnu nasrin, hadaathanaa husaynun alju'fiyuu, 'an zaaiidaaa, 'an maysaraaa, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man kaana yuuminu biallaahi waalyawmi alakhiri falaa yuudhiy jaarahu ‏"‏‏.‏ waastawsuwa bialniisaa'i khayrana faiinaahunaa khuliqna min dila'in waiinaa aa'waja shay'in fiy aldiila'i aa'laahu faiin dhahabta tuqiymuhu kasartahu waiin taraktahu lam yazal aa'waja faastawsuwa bialniisaa'i khayrana
translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not hurt (trouble) his neighbor. And I advise you to take care of the women, for they are created from a rib and the most crooked portion of the rib is its upper part; if you try to straighten it, it will break, and if you leave it, it will remain crooked, so I urge you to take care of the women
translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ مَا لِفَاطِمَةَ أَلاَ تَتَّقِي اللَّهَ، يَعْنِي فِي قَوْلِهَا لاَ سُكْنَى وَلاَ نَفَقَةَ
translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat maa lifaatimaaa aalaa tattaqiy alllaha, ya'niy fiy qawlihaa laa suknaa walaa nafaqaaa
translation: Narrated Al-Qasim:Aisha said, "What is wrong with Fatima? Why doesn't she fear Allah?" by saying that a divorced lady is not entitled to be provided with residence and sustenance (by her husband)
translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِنَّهُ لَيَمْنَعُنِي أَنْ أُحَدِّثَكُمْ حَدِيثًا كَثِيرًا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ تَعَمَّدَ عَلَىَّ كَذِبًا فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'niy abna 'ulayyaaa - 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni suhaybin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aannahu qaala iinnahu layamna'uniy aan auhaddithakum hadiythana kathiyrana aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man ta'ammada 'alaaaa kadhibana falyatabawwaa maq'adahu mina alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation: Zuhayr bin Harb narrated to me, Ismā’īl, rather, Ibn Ulayyah narrated to us, on authority of Abd il-Azīz ibn Suhayb, on authority of Anas bin Mālik, that he said:‘Indeed what prevents me from relating to you a great number of Ḥadīth is that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, said: ‘Whoever intends to lie upon me, then let him take his seat in the Fire.’
translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْغُبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَىَّ مُتَعَمِّدًا فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ubaydin alghubariyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy hasiynin, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man kadhaba 'alaaaa muta'ammidana falyatabawwaa maq'adahu mina alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation: Muhammad bin Ubayd il-Ghubarī narrated to us, Abū Awānah narrated to us, on authority of Abī Hasīn, on authority of Abī Sālih, on authority of Abū Hurayrah, he said, the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, said:‘Whoever lies upon me intentionally, then let him take his seat in the Fire’
translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالَ أَحْمَدُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُقَاتِلَ النَّاسَ حَتَّى يَقُولُوا لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ فَمَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ عَصَمَ مِنِّي مَالَهُ وَنَفْسَهُ إِلاَّ بِحَقِّهِ وَحِسَابُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, qaala aahmadu haddathanaa waqaala alakharaani, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aumirtu aan auqaatila alnnaasa hattaa yaquwluwa laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu faman qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu 'asama minniy maalahu wanafsahu iilaaa bihaqqihi wahisaabuhu 'alaa alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah said:I have been commanded to fight against people so long as they do not declare that there is no god but Allah, and he who professed it was guaranteed the protection of his property and life on my behalf except for the right affairs rest with Allah
translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، مَالِكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ وَاقِدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُقَاتِلَ النَّاسَ حَتَّى يَشْهَدُوا أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَيُقِيمُوا الصَّلاَةَ وَيُؤْتُوا الزَّكَاةَ فَإِذَا فَعَلُوا عَصَمُوا مِنِّي دِمَاءَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ إِلاَّ بِحَقِّهَا وَحِسَابُهُمْ عَلَى اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translit: haddathanaa aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, maaliku bnu 'abdi alwaahidi haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu alssabbaahi, 'an shu'baaa, 'an waaqidi bni muhammadi bni zaydi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aumirtu aan auqaatila alnnaasa hattaa yashhaduwa aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu waaanna muhammadana rasuwlu alllahi wayuqiymuwa alssalaaaa wayuutuwa alzzakaaaa faiidhaa fa'aluwa 'asamuwa minniy dimaa'ahum waaamwaalahum iilaaa bihaqqihaa wahisaabuhum 'alaa alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah said:I have been commanded to fight against people till they testify that there is no god but Allah, that Muhammad is the messenger of Allah, and they establish prayer, and pay Zakat and if they do it, their blood and property are guaranteed protection on my behalf except when justified by law, and their affairs rest with Allah
translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

original: וַ/יְכַ֤ל אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י מְלַאכְתּ֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַ/יִּשְׁבֹּת֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִ/כָּל מְלַאכְתּ֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה
translit: vykhl 'lhym byvm hshby'y ml'khtv 'shr 'shh vyshbt byvm hshby'y mkhl ml'khtv 'shr 'shh
translation: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

original: וַ/יְבָ֤רֶךְ אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת י֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י וַ/יְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֹת֑/וֹ כִּ֣י ב֤/וֹ שָׁבַת֙ מִ/כָּל מְלַאכְתּ֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁר בָּרָ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים לַ/עֲשֽׂוֹת
translit: vybrkh 'lhym 't yvm hshby'y vyqdsh 'tv khy bv shbt mkhl ml'khtv 'shr br' 'lhym l'shvt
translation: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.

original: וַ/יַּצְמַ֞ח יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ מִן הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה כָּל עֵ֛ץ נֶחְמָ֥ד לְ/מַרְאֶ֖ה וְ/ט֣וֹב לְ/מַאֲכָ֑ל וְ/עֵ֤ץ הַֽ/חַיִּים֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/גָּ֔ן וְ/עֵ֕ץ הַ/דַּ֖עַת ט֥וֹב וָ/רָֽע
translit: vytsmch yhvh 'lhym mn h'dmh khl 'ts nchmd lmr'h vtvb lm'khl v'ts hchyym btvkh hgn v'ts hd't tvb vr'
translation: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

original: וּ/מֵ/עֵ֗ץ הַ/דַּ֨עַת֙ ט֣וֹב וָ/רָ֔ע לֹ֥א תֹאכַ֖ל מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ כִּ֗י בְּ/י֛וֹם אֲכָלְ/ךָ֥ מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ מ֥וֹת תָּמֽוּת
translit: vm'ts hd't tvb vr' l' t'khl mmnv khy byvm 'khlkh mmnv mvt tmvt
translation: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.

original: ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च पणवानकगोमुखाः | सहसैवाभ्यहन्यन्त स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत्
translit: tataḥ śaṅkhāśca bheryaśca paṇavānakagomukhāḥ . sahasaivābhyahanyanta sa śabdastumulo.abhavat
translation: Just immediately after that conchs and kettledrums, and tabors, trumpets and cow-horns blared forth. That sound became tumultuous.

original: तत्रापश्यत्स्थितान्पार्थः पितॄनथ पितामहान् | आचार्यान्मातुलान्भ्रातॄन्पुत्रान्पौत्रान्सखींस्तथा
translit: tatrāpaśyatsthitānpārthaḥ pitṝnatha pitāmahān . ācāryānmātulānbhrātṛnputrānpautrānsakhīṃstathā
translation: Then Partha (Arjuna) saw, marshalled among both the armies, (his) uncles as also grandfathers, teachers, maternal uncles, brothers (and (cousins), sons, grandsons, as well as comrades and fathers-in-law and friends.

original: श्वशुरान्सुहृदश्चैव सेनयोरुभयोरपि | तान्समीक्ष्य स कौन्तेयः सर्वान्बन्धूनवस्थितान्
translit: śvaśurānsuhṛdaścaiva senayorubhayorapi . tānsamīkṣya sa kaunteyaḥ sarvānbandhūnavasthitān
translation: The son of Kunti (Ajuna), seeing all those rlatives arrayed (there), became overwhelmed by supreme compassion and said this sorrowfully:

original: यद्यप्येते न पश्यन्ति लोभोपहतचेतसः | कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं मित्रद्रोहे च पातकम्
translit: yadyapyete na paśyanti lobhopahatacetasaḥ . kulakṣayakṛtaṃ doṣaṃ mitradrohe ca pātakam
translation: 1.39  O Janardana, although these people, whose hearts have become perverted by greed, do not see the evil arising from destroying the family and sin in hostility towards, friends, yet how can we who clearly see the evil arising from destroying the family remain unaware of (the need of) abstaining from this sin?

original: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਵਿਖਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
translit: gaavai ko vidhiaa vikham veechaar ||
translation: Some sing of knowledge obtained of Him, through difficult philosophical studies.

original: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਜੀਅ ਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥
translit: gaavai ko jeea lai fir dheh ||
translation: Some sing that He takes life away, and then again restores it.

original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
translit: naanak vigasai veparavaahu ||3||
translation: O Nanak, He blossoms forth, Carefree and Untroubled. ||3||

original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਇ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
translit: saachaa saahib saach nai bhaakhiaa bhaau apaar ||
translation: True is the Master, True is His Name-speak it with infinite love.

original: וַיְכַ֤ל אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַיִּשְׁבֹּת֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִכׇּל־מְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃
translit: vykhl 'lhym byvm hshby'y ml'khtv 'shr 'shh vyshbt byvm hshby'y mkhlml'khtv 'shr 'shh
translation: And on the seventh day God finished His work which He had made; and He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had made.
translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

original: וַיְבָ֤רֶךְ אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־י֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וַיְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֹת֑וֹ כִּ֣י ב֤וֹ שָׁבַת֙ מִכׇּל־מְלַאכְתּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁר־בָּרָ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃ {פ}
translit: vybrkh 'lhym 'tyvm hshby'y vyqdsh 'tv khy bv shbt mkhlml'khtv 'shrbr' 'lhym l'shvt {p}
translation: And God blessed the seventh day, and hallowed it; because that in it He rested from all His work which God in creating had made.
translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

original: וַיַּצְמַ֞ח יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ מִן־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה כׇּל־עֵ֛ץ נֶחְמָ֥ד לְמַרְאֶ֖ה וְט֣וֹב לְמַאֲכָ֑ל וְעֵ֤ץ הַֽחַיִּים֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַגָּ֔ן וְעֵ֕ץ הַדַּ֖עַת ט֥וֹב וָרָֽע׃
translit: vytsmch yhvh 'lhym mnh'dmh khl'ts nchmd lmr'h vtvb lm'khl v'ts hchyym btvkh hgn v'ts hd't tvb vr'
translation: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

original: וּמֵעֵ֗ץ הַדַּ֙עַת֙ ט֣וֹב וָרָ֔ע לֹ֥א תֹאכַ֖ל מִמֶּ֑נּוּ כִּ֗י בְּי֛וֹם אֲכׇלְךָ֥ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ מ֥וֹת תָּמֽוּת׃
translit: vm'ts hd't tvb vr' l' t'khl mmnv khy byvm 'khlkh mmnv mvt tmvt
translation: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it; for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.’
translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

original: 大道廢，有仁義；智慧出，有大偽；六親不和，有孝慈；國家昏亂，有忠臣。
translation: When the Great Tao (Way or Method) ceased to be observed, benevolence and righteousness came into vogue. (Then) appeared wisdom and shrewdness, and there ensued great hypocrisy. When harmony no longer prevailed throughout the six kinships, filial sons found their manifestation; when the states and clans fell into disorder, loyal ministers appeared.
translationName: The Tâo Teh King (Sacred Books of the East, vol. 39)

original: 大成若缺，其用不弊。大盈若沖，其用不窮。大直若屈，其用不居。大巧若拙，其用不輟。大辯若訥，其用不差。躁勝寒，靜勝熱。清靜為天下正。
translation: Who thinks his great achievements poor Shall find his vigour long endure. Of greatest fulness, deemed a void, Exhaustion ne'er shall stem the tide. Do thou what's straight still crooked deem; Thy greatest art still stupid seem, And eloquence a stammering scream. Constant action overcomes cold; being still overcomes heat. Purity and stillness give the correct law to all under heaven.
translationName: The Tâo Teh King (Sacred Books of the East, vol. 39)

original: 不出戶，知天下；不闚牖，見天道。其出彌遠，其知彌少。是以聖人不行而知，不見而名，不為而成。
translation: Without going outside his door, one understands (all that takes place) under the sky; without looking out from his window, one sees the Tao of Heaven. The farther that one goes out (from himself), the less he knows. Therefore the sages got their knowledge without travelling; gave their (right) names to things without seeing them; and accomplished their ends without any purpose of doing so.
translationName: The Tâo Teh King (Sacred Books of the East, vol. 39)

original: 學而第一
translation: 1. The Master said, "Is it not pleasant to learn with a constant perseverance and application? 2. "Is it not delightful to have friends coming from distant quarters? 3. "Is he not a man of complete virtue, who feels no discomposure though men may take no note of him?" 【第二章】【一節】有子曰、其爲人也孝弟、而好犯上者鮮矣、不好犯上、而好作亂者、未之有也。【二節】君子務本、本立、而道生、孝弟也者、其爲仁之本與。
translationName: The Chinese Classics, Vol. I: Confucian Analects

original: 里仁第四
translation: The Master said, "It is virtuous manners which constitute the excellence of a neighborhood. If a man in selecting a residence, do not fix on one where such prevail, how can he be wise?"
translationName: The Chinese Classics, Vol. I: Confucian Analects

original: 行矣、言不忠信、行不篤敬、雖州里、行乎哉。 立、則見其參於前也、在輿、則見其倚於衡也、夫然後行。 子張書諸紳。
translation: The Master said, "When a man may be spoken with, not to speak to him is to err in reference to the man. When a man may not be spoken with, to speak to him is to err in reference to our words. The wise err neither in regard to their man nor to their words."
translationName: The Chinese Classics, Vol. I: Confucian Analects

original: 子曰、可與言、而不與之言、失人、不可與言、而與之言、失言、知者不失人、亦不失言。
translation: Tsze-kung asked about the practice of virtue. The Master said, "The mechanic, who wishes to do his work well, must first sharpen his tools. When you are living in any state, take service with the most worthy among its great officers, and make friends of the most virtuous among its scholars."
translationName: The Chinese Classics, Vol. I: Confucian Analects
